# KLVR

> KLVR is a creative, technology, marketing and business solutions company that creates, builds, connects and grows. KLVR helps founders, businesses, brands and organizations solve problems through digital products, software, automation, branding, marketing, business advisory, Web3 ecosystem growth and strategic partnerships.

## What we do

- KLVR Solutions: software, web and platform development, AI integrations, automation, brand identity, creative direction, digital marketing, growth strategy, business consulting and Web3 ecosystem support
- KLVR Products: owned digital products, platforms and tools, including Blocly
- KLVR Partnerships: strategic collaborations with specialist operators and industry partners, including partner-operated drone light show experiences
- KLVR Ventures: emerging research, product development, new business initiatives and commercial partnership exploration

## Who we serve

Startups, businesses, Web3 projects, organizations, entrepreneurs and partners in Nigeria and worldwide where the collaboration is a strong fit.
